Regelmatig means regularly; it does not mean continuously or on one specific channel.

Als ik van locatie verander, werk ik mij.scenario: A teammate asks how they can find your current availability. Explain the routine you follow whenever you change work location.

answers.text: Als ik van locatie verander, werk ik mijn bereikbaarheid in de agenda bij.
answers.english: When I change location, I update my contact availability in the calendar.
answers.explanation: Fronted subordinate clause. The first constituent is Als ik van locatie verander,; werk is the finite main verb and ik is its subject. The complete subordinate clause counts as the first constituent of the main clause. The main finite verb follows it, then the main subject. Inside the subordinate clause its own verb/group comes toward the end. The whole als-clause is the first constituent; werk follows before ik. Bijwerken splits as werk ... bij in the main clause.
